row_granularity: one row represents an individual claim
notes: The summary table appears on page 1, followed by detailed claim tables beginning on page 2. Claim table headers repeat on continuation pages. The detailed table continues across pages 3 and 4, with another section repeating the policy-period and claim headers on page 5. Status values are printed as C or O. Close Date contains both printed dates and unformatted numeric date serials such as 43438, 43769, 44413, 44439, and 44588. Policy periods are shown as date ranges under POLICY PERIOD; no Policy Number is shown.
